clause: Logic actions: set-variable + set-variable-mode + runtime expressions [STU-PRO-015,STU-PRO-016,STU-PRO-025]

scope.summary: Implement the logic actions writing/reading the shared StudioVariable primitives (MT-346/347) at runtime: set variable (writes a literal, alias, or expression result into a StudioVariable) and set variable mode (switches the active mode of a StudioVariableCollection for a target scope). Runtime expressions evaluate arithmetic on number variables, string concatenation, comparisons, and boolean logic, including reading mode-specific values. There is no separate prototype-only variable type. The set-variable/mode editor is an operator surface.
acceptance_criteria: set-variable + set-variable-mode + runtime expressions over shared StudioVariable; author_ids + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: set-variable + set-variable-mode editor reachable via author_ids
live: set-variable writes literal/alias/expression; set-variable-mode switches collection mode in scope; arithmetic/concat/compare/bool eval reads mode-specific values

risk_if_missed: No runtime variable writes; stateful/logic prototypes impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
